decisions.description: Approach individual teachers who want help directly, rather than going through the schools, which were uncooperative
Train someone to answer the phones, on a separate number, rather than use an external answering service

actions.description: Send over the details of the school running an English as a second language programme, whose teachers are good candidates
Find a standard release form for the parents to sign before the testimonial videos
Put Beth in contact with the parents who agreed to record testimonials
Find somebody to shoot the testimonial videos and edit them properly
Start looking for candidates to answer the phones

risks.description: Training a dedicated phone answerer will cost more than using a service, because it means an employee

open_questions.description: Whether a script is enough for the phone answerer or real training is needed, given callers will ask surprise questions

notes: Linda's video commitments are recorded as ONE action, not two. She offers to recommend her video guy at seg-0098 and then accepts the whole find-and-edit task at seg-0122; that is the same commitment widening, so the frozen contract's revision rule applies -- one item, final state, cited where it settled. Rachel's 'two weeks from now or months after' (seg-0090) is far too vague to be a deadline even if the corpus had a meeting date. The child-on-video concern is raised and answered within the case (blur the face), so it is not recorded as a risk.
